rows.item: Hot-side sink, 75 tangential x 70 radial x 45, fins radial (simulated R_hot ~0.67 K/W ducted)
rows.supplier: Alutronic (DE, direct; no UK distributor found)
rows.verified: Alutronic spec sheet (thermal/datasheets/alutronic_pr614.pdf): 75 W x 45 H, 5 mm base, EN AW-6060; 22 fins counted on maker profile, ~3.5 mm pitch, ~1.35 mm mean fin [est]. plenum_cad.py PR614_L70: R_hot 0.667 K/W (simulation).
rows.notes: 2026-10-26 sink study (kb/plenum-sizing.md): no RS/Farnell/UK-stocked profile <=70 mm wide with fine fins exists; PR 614 is 5 mm over the 70 mm tangential envelope, so CAD must check pl_hot_sink [70,75,45]. Stocked trial part Fischer SK 100 75 SA (Farnell 4621827 GBP15.23, RS 189-8088; 7 fins, 10 mm base per Fischer drawing) simulates R_hot 1.36-1.47 K/W and makes every layout infeasible: do not buy it for the cooling build.

rows.item: Cold-side sink, 74.5 radial x 46 along flow x 22, fins along the flow
rows.supplier: Alutronic (DE, direct; no UK distributor found)
rows.verified: Alutronic spec sheet (thermal/datasheets/alutronic_pr411.pdf): 74.5 W x 22 H, 3 mm base, EN AW-6060; 13 serrated fins at ~6.03 mm pitch, ~1.7 mm [est]. plenum_cad.py PR411_L46: R_cold 1.81 K/W (60 mm: 1.63) (simulation).
rows.notes: 2026-10-26 sink study: 46 mm keeps the 74.5 mm-wide sink's corners inside the outer lip with pl_cold_dr 1.25; 60 mm needs a lip relief. Order together with PR 614 (same maker). Stocked trial part TDEX6015/TH (RS 158-562, GBP12.22; 60 x 16 x 60, 15 slots of ~1.8 mm [est from TED drawing]) leaves ~90 % of loop air bypassing (R_cold 6.8 K/W): do not buy.
